articles.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
articles.description: According to the Financial Times, OpenAI disbanded its preparedness team at the end of last month. The job of the preparedness team was to assess if models posed serious risks and develop ways to mitigate those risks. articles.title: Amazon is trying to crush class-action suits before they get started
articles.description: On Friday, Amazon customers received an email alerting them to an update to the site's terms and conditions. articles.description: ChatGPT's desktop app on macOS has a new feature called Computer History that turns your actions into training data, learning how you work, suggesting automations, and even picking up tasks you left half done.
